description: Search ClinicalTrials.gov (API v2) by condition, keyword, location, sponsor, recruitment status (or open/closed) and phase. Returns NCT id, title, status, phases, study type, conditions, interventions, lead sponsor, start and completion dates, enrollment, results flag, a short summary and up to 5 sites (ranked by your location), with total count and a page token. Informational only, not medical advice. Price: $0.02 USDC per successful call (x402, Solana). Same tool over HTTPS: GET https://scorptech.it.com/api/x402/v1/clinical-trials

condition.description: Condition or disease, e.g. type 2 diabetes

status.description: Comma list: open, closed, recruiting, not_yet_recruiting, active_not_recruiting, completed, terminated, ...

term.description: Other keywords (drug, NCT id, ...). Alias: q

name: clinical_trials
title: Clinical Trials
